Please solve this issue: The spend report books each exported usage line against its first attribution code even when that code passes the cost through a chain to another owner. Produce one row for every code that ultimately carries spend, with its metered quantity, money and contributing line count. Place every amount under exactly one final code rather than an intermediate code. If a chain repeats, use the charge code shared by that cycle. The onboarding record in the metering bucket identifies readable accounts and the locations of exports and attribution material. This task includes a local AWS-compatible emulator at the preconfigured AWS_ENDPOINT_URL. Default region name [None]: us-east-1
Default output format [None]: json
